prompt: Compose one complete original 30-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: spare koto groove with spacious precise rhythmic gestures. Instruments: koto, muted synth bass, tight electronic drums, bamboo clicks. Tempo 110 BPM. Distinct motif: two staccato notes and an octave leap. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 25-second product-demo film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:28, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: An energetic and driving electronic track featuring a prominent synth melody, a strong beat, and a pulsing bassline, concluding with a sustained synth pad.

description.en: An electronic track featuring a driving beat, melodic synth lead, and evolving synth pads. The arrangement builds with layered synthesizers, creating an energetic and modern sound.
description.zh: 一首电子音乐，具有强劲的节拍、旋律优美的合成器主音和不断变化的合成器铺底。编曲通过分层合成器构建，营造出充满活力和现代感的声音。
